nodes.label: App Shell (Sidebar) Pattern
nodes.rationale: Reused across all authenticated dashboard pages (fixed 264px sidebar + topbar + mobile drawer) so navigation, account menu, and branding stay identical regardless of which dashboard screen the user is on.

nodes.label: Auth Card Shell Pattern
nodes.rationale: Shared chromeless centered-card layout (no marketing navbar) used for every auth/transitional screen (Signup, Login, OTP, Profile Completion, Payment Verification) to keep the user focused on a single task without navigation distractions, per design.md.

nodes.label: Pay-to-Unlock Draft Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Core product mechanic: admin prepares a draft, user sees only an expert summary until payment is completed, then the full draft is revealed. Encoded in Service Detail's payUnlockLocked/draftReveal panels and the lock-icon animation; ensures the client sees evidence of work before paying (see KB2 payment flow).

nodes.label: Booking Status State Machine
nodes.rationale: The six-status booking lifecycle (Document Upload -> In Review -> Draft Ready -> Payment Received -> Filing -> Complete, plus Cancelled) is encoded as STATUS_CONFIG in Service Detail and reused as badge classes (s-upload, s-review, s-draft, s-filing, s-complete, s-cancelled) across Services List and Payment History so status always renders consistently.

nodes.label: OTP Segmented Input Pattern
nodes.rationale: Explicitly flagged in-file as a new UI pattern not yet in components.md — a 6-box segmented numeric input with paste-distribution, backspace-retreat, and per-box error/success/locked states, intended for promotion to the shared component library.

nodes.label: GNS Client Session State (js/app-state.js)
nodes.rationale: A shared client-side script (GNS.setSession, GNS.getActiveBookingId, GNS.updateBooking, GNS.wireLogoutLinks) that simulates the auth/session and booking-status persistence layer across the prototype, standing in for what will become real JWT-cookie auth and API calls.

nodes.label: Marketing Navbar Component
nodes.rationale: Identical sticky navbar (brand, Services dropdown, About/Resources/Pricing links, phone CTA, mobile drawer) is duplicated verbatim across every public marketing page; several pages annotate it explicitly as components.md -> Navbar, signalling it is meant to become one shared component.

nodes.label: Marketing Footer Component
nodes.rationale: Identical four-column footer (brand/CIN/GSTIN, Services, Resources, Contact + Grievance Officer) duplicated across every public marketing page, annotated on several pages as components.md -> Footer.

nodes.label: WhatsApp Float CTA Pattern
nodes.rationale: A floating WhatsApp button (wa.me deep link) plus a sticky mobile bottom bar that both reveal after ~200-240px of scroll; implements KB1's no-in-platform-messaging rule by routing all chat to WhatsApp outside the platform.

nodes.label: Mobile Bottom Tab Bar
nodes.rationale: Fixed 4-item bottom navigation (Dashboard/Services/Payments/Settings) shown only on <lg dashboard viewports, replacing the sidebar as primary navigation on mobile.

nodes.label: Pre-Deposit Disclosure Requirement
nodes.rationale: KB2 mandates the statutory government pre-deposit (10% for Commissioner Appeal, 20% for GSTAT Appeal) be disclosed as clearly NOT part of the platform fee at four touchpoints: pricing page, booking flow, draft-ready email, and pay-to-unlock screen -- this chunk shows it implemented on the GSTAT service page, Pricing cards, FAQ, and the Service Detail pay-unlock panel.

nodes.label: Design Tokens (css/tokens.css)
nodes.rationale: Single locked CSS custom-property source (colors, radii, shadows) imported by every full page in the prototype so no page hardcodes hex values, matching frontend.md's design-token rule.

nodes.label: Preview State Switcher (Design Review Tool)
nodes.rationale: A fixed floating control (not part of product UI, explicitly commented 'review only') that lets a reviewer toggle between a screen's possible backend-driven states (loading/populated/empty/error/status variants) inside a static HTML prototype.

nodes.label: Service Status Badge Component
nodes.rationale: A reusable pill badge (icon + label, color keyed to status) mapping 1:1 onto the booking status state machine; identical markup/classes reused verbatim in Service Detail, Services List, and Payment History.

nodes.label: FAQ Accordion Pattern
nodes.rationale: Single-item-expansion accordion with chevron rotation, used both as the dedicated FAQ page's full searchable list and as a shorter embedded FAQ section on Homepage and Pricing -- each implemented independently rather than shared.
